scope: Bounded provenance check for AI Act Articles 6 and 113 only

temporary_comparison_normalizations.name: strip_outer_amendment_quotes
temporary_comparison_normalizations.description: On temporary derived text for Amending Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 quoted blocks only, strips the single leading opening quote (‘) and/or single trailing closing quote (’) enclosing the quoted provision, and excludes the trailing ';' paragraph sibling that terminates the amending point row. Internal quotes, punctuation, and symbols are preserved.

temporary_comparison_normalizations.name: exclude_consolidated_modref_elements_for_residual_check
temporary_comparison_normalizations.description:
On temporary derived comparison copies of consolidated Articles 6 and 113, excludes

editorial revision markers ('▼M1', '▼B') when comparing residual wording against the original 2024 OJ edition.

article_6_check.operation_label: in Article 6, the following paragraphs are inserted:
article_6_check.quoted_amendment_text: ‘1a. For the purposes of this Regulation, including paragraph 1 of this Article, AI systems that are solely used for non-safety related aspects of user assistance, performance optimisation, service efficiency, automation or convenience or quality control shall not qualify as safety components. 1b. Notwithstanding paragraph 1a, AI systems the failure or malfunctioning of which would endanger health and safety shall qualify as safety components. 1c. A product that is required to undergo a third-party conformity assessment solely due to risks other than risks to health and safety, in particular risks relating to the distribution of radio spectrum or electromagnetic interference that do not affect health and safety, shall not be considered as fulfilling the condition in paragraph 1, point (b).’
